unexpected: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
forbidden: You don't have access to do this.
cannotChangeSelf: You can't change the role or status of your own account.
lastAdmin: At least one active admin must remain. Promote another admin first.
dateTooSoon: Travel date must be at least 3 days from today.
invalidParticipants: Number of travellers doesn't fit this tour's capacity.
capacityExceeded: Not enough seats left on that date. Please choose another.
dateClosed: This date is closed for bookings. Please choose another date.
closureRange: Choose dates from today onwards, at most 92 days at a time and within the next 12 months.
tripNotStarted: A booking can only be marked completed from its travel date onwards.
notCancellable: This booking can no longer be cancelled.
slugTaken: That page address is already in use. Choose another one.
staleEdit: Someone else (or another tab) changed this just now. To avoid overwriting their change, reload the page and make your edit again.
slugLocked: A live tour's page address can't be changed, so links people have shared keep working. Switch off Publish on site first if you really need a new address.
notPayable: This booking can't be paid. Make sure it is still pending and the travel date hasn't passed.
alreadyPaid: This booking has already been paid.
paymentUnavailable: Online payment is currently unavailable. Please contact us.
paymentGateway: Couldn't reach the payment service. Please try again shortly.
notRefundable: Only a paid payment can be marked as refunded.
creditInUse: This credit cannot be deleted because its photo is still shown on the site.
notReschedulable: This booking can no longer be moved to another date.
rescheduleLimit: This booking has already been moved. The reschedule limit has been reached.
rescheduleTooLate: Date changes are closed because the travel date is too close.
sameDate: Choose a date different from the current travel date.
refundChanged: The refund amount has changed since you opened this page. Please review it and confirm again.
guideUnavailable: That guide doesn't exist or is no longer active.
guideNoEmail: This guide has no email address. Add one to the guide's record or send it via WhatsApp.
departureEmpty: There are no active bookings on this departure.
guideAccountNotFound: No registered account uses this email. Ask the partner to sign up first.
guideAccountBackoffice: Staff and admin accounts cannot become partner accounts.
guideAccountDisabled: This account is disabled. Enable it on the users page first.
guideAccountLinked: This account is already linked to another guide.
guideAlreadyLinked: This guide already has a portal account. Unlink it before linking another one.

fields.guideNotesMax: Notes can be at most 2000 characters.
fields.closureRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.
fields.closureTooLong: Close at most 92 days at a time.
fields.closureTooFar: Dates must be within the next 12 months.
fields.closureReason: Reason must be 200 characters or fewer.
fields.tooLong: Too long: at most {max, number} characters.
fields.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
fields.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters.
fields.notesMax: Notes must be 500 characters or fewer.
fields.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (-) between words, without spaces.
fields.priceMin: Enter a price per person of at least Rp 10,000.
fields.priceMax: That price is too high. Check the number of zeros.
fields.durationHours: Enter a whole number from 1 to 12, or leave it empty.
fields.durationHoursSameDay: Duration (hours) is only for 1-day tours. Leave it empty, or set Duration (days) to 1.
fields.linesMismatch: The Indonesian and English columns have a different number of lines. Every line needs its translation.
fields.lineTooLong: A line is too long: at most {max, number} characters per line.
fields.tooManyLines: Too many lines: at most {max, number}.
fields.tooManyPhotos: Too many photos: at most {max, number}.
fields.includedRequired: List at least one thing the price includes.
fields.itineraryDays: The itinerary needs exactly one entry for each day of Duration (days).
fields.refundNote: Enter 3 to 500 characters, for example the bank transfer reference.
fields.departureNote: Notes can be at most 1000 characters.
